author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.5.2 — Adds the standard Switch capability (on()/off(), switch attribute) so the vacuum works as a plain switch in Alexa/Google routines, Rule Machine, and Dashboard, with no separate virtual switch device needed. Which action on()/off() perform is configurable per device (default: on -> Clean Next Rooms, off -> Dock). The switch attribute is also kept in sync with real vacuum state from polling, not just the last command tapped.
